source.title: GoviEx completes definitive feasibility study for the Muntanga Uranium Project

text:
GoviEx completes definitive feasibility study for the Muntanga Uranium Project

GoviEx Uranium Inc. said on Monday that it has completed a definitive feasibility study for the Muntanga Uranium Project in Siavonga district, Southern Province.

The study shows an open pit operation with a life of 12 years and a capital cost of US$180 million. The mine will produce about 1,500 tonnes of uranium oxide a year at full capacity. GoviEx plans to start the search for project finance in the first quarter of 2027.

The company expects to make a construction decision in 2027.
